notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start(7)': This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further, Cloud City: Upper Walkway, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion and Secret Plans; these count toward the 60. The strategy says the objective lets Secret Plans start as a fourth Effect, so it is the starting Effect (an Effect in 2001, not a Defensive Shield).
Posted 'Tdigwatt/pidaiaf' dested the objective This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further.

Posted 'Ig-88 with Captive' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun, the only 'IG-88 With …' character card (its riot gun captures characters); 'Boba and gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Dr e and pb' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Emp Palp.' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Choke Vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith.

Posted 'Bespin' and 'BespinCloud City' dested the Dark printings Bespin (Dark) and Bespin: Cloud City (Dark); 'CC Db' dested the Dark site Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Wakemuli' dested Wakeelmui; 'Dreadnought' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser.
The strategy says the poster won an unnamed tournament 'this weekend' with the deck; no event is named, so the deck is listed as general.
